name: monozukuri
description: The monozukuri software-craftsmanship skill suite: an umbrella skill plus 11 focused skills for building and maintaining software as a craft.

plugins.name: monozukuri
plugins.description: Japanese-inspired software craftsmanship: inspect reality, simplify deliberately, change small, prevent defects, verify with evidence, leave the system maintainable. Umbrella skill plus 11 focused skills (nemawashi, genchi-genbutsu, kanso, kata, jidoka, poka-yoke, kodawari, andon, kaizen, hansei, shukka).
